fees.name: Cleaning fee
fees.note: Not refundable. Due ten days before the event.

fees.name: Security and damage deposit
fees.note: Due with the application, and it holds the date. Returned in full within fifteen days if the hall is left in order.

waivers.name: Funeral or celebration of life
waivers.note: The hall is free. The cleaning fee still applies.

options.name: Kitchen
options.note: Stove, refrigerator, the kitchen side of the walk-in, and the washing up. No utensils are provided.

insurance.named: San Joaquin Valley Swiss Club, Inc.

guards.note: State of California licensed, from a company the Swiss Club Manager has approved. On site one hour before and one hour after, and the premises are vacated when they leave.

holdHarmless.note: A member who chooses not to have security guards signs the club's hold harmless statement instead.

cancellation.note: The deposit is returned less a $50 processing fee.
Half of the deposit is returned.

rules.noSales: The hall is for private parties. It is not open to the public and no beverages may be sold.
